references.text: Isaiah 55:1 calls all who thirst to come to God, a call that parallels Jesus' words by inviting people to come to Him without fear of being rejected.
John 10:28-29 directly repeats the theme of eternal life and security, where Jesus confirms that no one can snatch them out of His hand, just as He will not cast out anyone who comes to Him.
John 17:2 points to the same divine authority where the Father has given people into the Son's care, and the Son's task is to keep them, reflecting the mechanism in John 6:37.

John 17:6 confirms that those whom the Father gave into the Son's care belong to Him, and the Son's responsibility is to keep them, a direct parallel to the promise that none of those given will be cast out.
John 17:12 emphasizes that none of those the Father gave into the Son's care were lost, which is the historical fulfillment of the promise that He will not cast out anyone who comes.
